notes: The dead-air ask. Nothing is happening, so sending people somewhere is the most useful thing to do with the silence rather than an interruption of it.
variants: Nothing moving right now, so while we wait — {community_platform}'s {community_name}, {community_where}. Come say hello.
Quiet patch. Good time to join the {community_platform}, it's {community_name}, {community_where}.
While it's slow — the {community_platform} group is {community_name}. {community_where} if you want in.

notes: Earned by a moment. A plug straight after something happened has a reason to exist, which is the difference between a mention and an advert.
variants: Moves like that get talked about properly in the {community_platform}. {community_name}, {community_where}.
That's the sort of thing we go over in {community_name} on {community_platform}. {community_where}.
If you want the levels written down rather than just said out loud, that's {community_name} on {community_platform}.

notes: Aimed at people who arrived mid-stream, which on a rolling live stream is most of them.
variants: If you've just walked in — {community_name} on {community_platform}, {community_where}. That's where the rest of it lives.
For anyone who just joined: {community_name}, on {community_platform}. {community_where}.

notes: Tied to the clock. A reason to join *now* rather than eventually, because something is about to start.
variants: {next_session} opens in {minutes_to_next_session}. If you want to watch it with people, {community_name} on {community_platform}.
Session's about to turn. {community_name}, {community_platform}, {community_where} — that's where it gets busy.

notes: The direct one, kept low priority so it only surfaces when nothing better fits. Every stream needs a plain ask; it just should not be the usual one.
variants: Quick one — the {community_platform} is {community_name}. {community_where}. That's the only plug you'll get for a while.

notes: Late in a long stream, thanks first and the ask second. It reads as gratitude rather than a pitch because the order is honest.
variants: Long session, and you're still here. Appreciate it. {community_name} on {community_platform} if you want to keep it going, {community_where}.
Thanks for sitting through the quiet bits with me. The {community_platform} is {community_name}.
Still here after all that. Respect. {community_name}, {community_platform}, {community_where}.
